title: Regional Sales Manager — North India
description: We are seeking an experienced Regional Sales Manager to lead EduSoft's sales operations across North India. The successful candidate will drive revenue growth, manage a team of field sales executives, and build long-term relationships with hospitals, diagnostic centres, and distributors.
responsibilities: Achieve regional sales targets for the imaging hardware and software portfolio
Build and manage a team of 4–6 field sales representatives
Develop and maintain relationships with key accounts (hospitals, radiology chains, government health departments)
Identify and onboard new channel partners and distributors
Provide market intelligence and competitive analysis to the product team
Represent EduSoft at regional trade exhibitions and clinical conferences
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or Business; MBA preferred
5–8 years of experience in medical device / healthcare technology sales
Proven track record of achieving sales targets in a B2B medical environment
Strong network within radiology, orthopedics, or diagnostic imaging sectors
Excellent communication and negotiation skills
Willingness to travel extensively within the region

title: Application Engineer — Medical Imaging
description: Join our applications team to provide technical support, product training, and clinical workflow optimization for EduSoft's installed base across India and international markets.
responsibilities: Deliver product demonstrations and hands-on training at customer sites
Support installation, commissioning, and acceptance testing of imaging systems
Provide clinical application support to radiology technologists and physicians
Conduct remote and on-site troubleshooting for application-level issues
Develop training materials and application guides
Provide feedback to the product team on clinical usage patterns and improvement areas
requirements: Degree or diploma in Radiography, Medical Imaging Technology, or Biomedical Engineering
2–5 years of experience in medical imaging applications or clinical support
Hands-on experience with DR/CR systems, PACS, or surgical imaging
Strong communication and presentation skills
Willingness to travel up to 60% of the time

title: Software Engineer — AI & Medical Imaging
description: We are looking for a talented software engineer to join the EduSoft AI team, contributing to the development and enhancement of our medical imaging AI platform including the TB Screening AI product.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain backend services for AI inference pipelines
Build DICOM integration layers for PACS and acquisition workstation interfaces
Optimize model serving infrastructure for sub-30 second processing
Implement clinical audit trail and compliance features
Collaborate with radiologists and clinical advisors on AI output validation
Contribute to regulatory documentation for medical device software submissions
requirements: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
3–6 years of professional software development experience
Proficiency in Python; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Experience with DICOM, HL7, or healthcare interoperability standards preferred
Familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, and cloud deployment
Interest in regulated software development (IEC 62304) is a plus

title: Field Service Engineer
description: Field Service Engineers at EduSoft are the technical backbone of our customer relationships — responsible for installation, preventive maintenance, and repair of medical imaging equipment at customer sites across India.
responsibilities: Install, commission, and perform acceptance testing of imaging systems
Execute planned preventive maintenance visits per service schedule
Diagnose and repair hardware and software faults on customer sites
Maintain accurate service records and escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support
Support customers with basic operational training
Manage assigned spare parts inventory
requirements: Diploma or Bachelor's in Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
1–4 years of field service experience in medical equipment or similar industry
Ability to read electrical schematics and technical manuals
Strong problem-solving and customer-facing communication skills
Valid driving licence; willingness to travel extensively
